mapper.select: SELECT s.send_log_id, s.campaign_id, c.name AS campaign_name, s.channel, s.kind, s.status, s.error_message, s.created_at, s.sent_at, (SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM track_event e WHERE e.send_log_id = s.send_log_id AND e.event_type = 'OPEN' AND e.bot_yn = 'N') AS opened_at, (SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM track_event e WHERE e.send_log_id = s.send_log_id AND e.event_type = 'CLICK' AND e.bot_yn = 'N') AS clicked_at FROM send_log s LEFT JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id WHERE s.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.send_log_id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT i.issue_id, i.coupon_id, c.name AS coupon_name, CASE WHEN i.used_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'USED' WHEN CURRENT_DATE < c.valid_from THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN CURRENT_DATE > c.valid_to THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'USABLE' END AS status, c.valid_from, c.valid_to, i.issued_at, i.used_at FROM coupon_issue i JOIN coupon c ON c.coupon_id = i.coupon_id WHERE i.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY i.issued_at DESC, i.issue_id DESC
